info.name: Noyo Carrier Carrier Mapped Field Dependent API
Get a single Dependent by Group

params.name: group_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the group which the dependent you would like to query belows to

params.name: dependent_id
params.description: Either the Noyo ID or the Custom Individual ID of the dependent you would like to query

items.docs: Returns the latest version of a single dependent based on the Group and ID provided.

info.name: Get a single Dependent by Group and Employee ID

params.name: group_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the group which the dependent you would like to query belows to

params.name: employee_id
params.description: Either the Noyo ID or the Custom Individual ID of the employee which the dependent you would like to query belows to

params.name: dependent_id
params.description: Either the Noyo ID or the Custom Individual ID of the dependent you would like to query

items.docs: Returns the latest version of a single dependent based on the Group, Employee and ID provided.
